call.title: Release notes — 2.4.0
call.content:
Release notes — 2.4.0
2.4.0 since v2.3.1: 3 for users, 2 for operators, 3 upgrade steps, 1 known issue

## For users
- Share a weekly meal plan with one other person in your household by email.
- Discount codes you mistype now give a clear message instead of an empty basket.
- The orders page loads faster for accounts with thousands of orders.

## For operators
- New setting `SHARE_FROM_ADDRESS` (shop/config.py:2): the address invitations are sent from; the app refuses to start without it.
- PostgreSQL's data folder moves to /mnt/fast/pg (Change record — move the database to the new disk); the nightly backup reads the new path.

## Upgrade notes
1. Back up the database (`pg_dump shop > shop-2.3.1.sql`).
2. Run the migrations — 0042 drops `orders.notes`; no simple return after this step.
3. Set `SHARE_FROM_ADDRESS` and restart.

## Known issues
- Sending mail retries forever when the mail server is down (tests/test_mail.py::test_retry_stops, failing since 2026-11-03); workaround: restart the worker.
